violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Bottom of reach-in freezer on line found with debris, needs cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Hoods found dusty

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration - Found dishwasher at 0ppm CL at time of inspection.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. - Bucket found in handwash sink at time of inspection.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. - Aprons and coats found hung in kitchen where food is stored.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Items throughout kitchen found undated.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. - Chest freezer in basement needs repair, lid is broken.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
